positive_terms: Has assigned responsibility at top management level for equal treatment and opportunities in employment, issue clear company-wide policies and procedures to guide equal employment practices, and link advancement to desired performance in this area
高层对平等就业机会的责任与落实
说明主体是否在高层管理层指定平等就业机会责任，发布全公司政策与程序，并将晋升与该领域表现挂钩。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
